Name: Better Quest Rewards
Author: FoxIsADev
Description:
[b][size=5]Better Quest Rewards[/size][/b]
makes the [b]Help Wanted[/b] board (Pierre’s shop) stay worth doing all game.

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/0pL99bLT/How-It-Works-1.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*][b]Rewards scale smoothly as you progress[/b] (no weird Year 3/4 spikes).
[*][b]Completing Help Wanted quests increases future payouts[/b] (stacks, capped).
[*]Keeps the [b]billboard text, quest journal text, and the gold you actually get[/b] matching.
[/list][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/8DL4rkNV/New-Project-4.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*][b]Year 1:[/b] ~85–175g
[*][b]Year 2:[/b] ~200–520g
[*][b]Year 3:[/b] ~1,600–2,000g
[*][b]Year 4:[/b] ~2,500–3,000g
[*][b]Year 5:[/b] ~4,000–5,000g
[*][i](Your exact reward depends on the quest + your progress.)[/i]
[/list]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/gbnfHYx8/supported-quest-types-6.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*]Item Delivery
[*]Slay Monsters
[*]Fishing
[*]Resource Collection
[/list]
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/hn0jJWm/supported-quest-types-5.png[/img][/url]
Stardew Valley 1.6+ with SMAPI.
Safe to add mid-save.
Safe to remove(it won’t break your save).

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Ld4SQm4t/supported-quest-types-7.png[/img][/url]
Install SMAPI.
Unzip into: Stardew Valley/Mods
Launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]Uninstall[/b]
[list]
[*]Remove the mod folder from Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/list][b]Changelog v1.1.0 [/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]Added config + optional GMCM menu (Scaling Mode, Reward Cap, Lock toggle).
[*]Rebalanced Help Wanted scaling (better early game, stronger mid/late).
[*]Completing Help Wanted quests now boosts future rewards (stacking, capped). [/spoiler]
[/list][b]Changelog v1.0.1[/b] [spoiler] 
[list]
[*]Reworked reward scaling to be smooth and consistent through all years
[*]Added bonus growth from completing Help Wanted quests (stacking, capped)
[*]Fixed reward syncing so board/journal/payout always match
[*]Scoped the mod strictly to Help Wanted quests only [/spoiler]
[/list][b]Author Info:
[/b]This is my first Stardew mod (I’m 17). I wanted a reason to keep doing Pierres Help Wanted quests even after you start making serious money, so I built a scaling system that stays rewarding without crazy spikes. If something feels unbalanced, tell me your year + the quest reward and I’ll tune it =)
